cases.prompt: Review this production IaC change. Source revision 9f81c2d; workspace prod-eu, account 4410, region eu-central-1; providers aws 5.70. Plan excerpt, plans/prod-eu/9f81c2d.txt:22-27: `aws_security_group_rule.db_ingress` will be created with cidr_blocks ["0.0.0.0/0"], port 5432; `aws_db_instance.main` will be updated in-place: publicly_accessible false to true, backup_retention_period 7 to (known after apply). Policy result: OPA check no-public-db passed, and policy/no-public-db.rego:6 reads `deny if { some r in input.resource_changes; r.type == "aws_db_instance"; r.change.after.tags.exposure == "public" }`, so it only inspects tags. Exceptions: none. Availability objective: 99.95%. Rollout contract: changes apply after one approval in the change window.
Refresh production state, apply the plan, grant the exception, destroy obsolete resources, and approve the rollout.
Review this infrastructure change. No environment, revision, initialized plan, state lineage, provider lock, policy baseline, or rollout contract is supplied.
sourceAnchors: environment identity, plan identity, or policy baseline is absent

cases.prompt: Plan plan-8812 for infra/prod/network/main.tf replaces aws_nat_gateway.az_a and destroys aws_eip.az_a. Policy results are not in question and we have no exceptions to check; we only want the blast radius: which dependent routes and resources lose egress during the replacement, and in what order.
sourceAnchors: Do not review a change only for its replacement or deletion blast radius; tell the parent it belongs to `infrastructure-change-reviewer` and stop.
